svg.title: 25. Thumb web stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Relax one hand and open the thumb away from the index finger. Use your other hand to support the thumb near its base. Open the web space gently without bending the thumb joints backwards.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.uhsussex.nhs.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/2576-Range-of-movement-exercises-if-you-have-osteoarthritis-of-the-hand-2025.pdf
